lines.text: Many learners say: I have been waiting from morning.
Better: I have been waiting since morning.
Use since for the start time.
Since! I have waited since morning.

data.wrong: I have been waiting from morning.
data.right: I have been waiting since morning.
data.why: Use since for the start time.

native.tip: हिंदी में “सुबह से” का “से” अंग्रेज़ी में from बन जाता है; शुरुआत का समय बताने के लिए since बोलें।
native.caption: क्या आप भी यही कहते हैं? “I have been waiting from morning.” 😅 सही रूप है “I have been waiting since morning.” क्योंकि शुरुआत का समय बताने के लिए since आता है। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “since”। अब इसी तरह अपना एक वाक्य लिखिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Learners often use from for a start time, but English uses since.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I have been waiting from morning.” 😅 The right way is “I have been waiting since morning.” This is right because since shows the start time. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
